app.name: panel.cypek.dev

setup.title: Welcome to HomePanel
setup.subtitle: Create the owner account to get started. This takes a minute.
setup.tokenHelp: Printed in the terminal by the installer, and saved in the data directory as setup-token. It proves you control this machine.
setup.usernameHelp: 2–32 characters: letters, digits, dot, underscore or dash.
setup.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Longer is better than complicated.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage your servers.
login.totpSubtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.totpHelp: A 6-digit code from the app, or one of your backup codes (xxxxx-xxxxx).

servers.createDescription: Point the panel at any program and it will supervise it like a game server. No shell: one argument per line.
servers.name: Name
servers.commandHelp: Program name or absolute path, e.g. /usr/bin/java. No shell syntax.
servers.stopCommandHelp: Typed into the console on stop, e.g. stop or quit. Empty sends SIGTERM.
servers.stopTimeoutHelp: After this long the process is killed.
servers.readyRegexHelp: Optional. When the console matches it, the state switches from Starting to Running.
servers.autostartHelp: Start this server automatically after a reboot.
servers.notFound: This server does not exist or was deleted.
servers.noShell: Commands run directly, without a shell: no pipes, quotes or $VARIABLES. Put each argument on its own line.
servers.settingsDescription: Changes to the command apply on the next start.
servers.dangerDescription: Deleting removes the server from the panel. Files are removed too unless you keep them.
servers.deleteDescription: "{{name}}" will be removed from the panel. This cannot be undone.
servers.deleteFiles: Also delete the server files from disk
servers.deleteRequiresStopped: Stop the server before deleting it.
servers.cpuPercentHint: 0 = unlimited. 100 means one full CPU core, 200 two cores.
servers.appliesOnRestart: Changes to the command, arguments or environment apply on the next start.

validation.envLine: Line {{line}}: use NAME=value, where NAME has only letters, digits and underscores.
validation.regex: This is not a valid regular expression.

power.killConfirm: Force stop kills the process immediately. Unsaved data may be lost.

templates.title: New server
templates.pickHelp: Pick what you want to run. The panel downloads everything the server needs.
templates.loadError: Could not load the list of games.
templates.customDescription: Point the panel at any program and it will supervise it like a game server. For advanced users.
templates.settingsHelp: You can change all of this later in the server settings.
templates.memoryLimitHelp: 0 = no limit. This is a hard cap for the whole server process, separate from the memory given to Java.
templates.summaryHelp: Check the settings. Installation starts right after you confirm.
templates.portsTitle: Ports to open on your router
templates.noPorts: This server needs no open ports.
templates.portsHelp: Forward these ports to this machine so friends outside your network can join. On the LAN it works without forwarding.
templates.installNote: Installation downloads the server files (and Java if needed). It can take a few minutes depending on your connection.
templates.consentRequired: You have to accept this to continue.
templates.consentAccepted: Accepted when the server was created.
templates.optionsError: Could not fetch the version list.
templates.settingsDescription: Changes to version or Java settings apply after the next start. Changing the port updates the server config right away.
templates.reinstallDescription: Downloads the server files again (and updates to the newest build of the chosen version). Your world, plugins and configuration stay in place. The server must be stopped.

install.title: Installing
install.failedGeneric: Something went wrong during installation. Check the log below and try again.
install.waitingLog: Waiting for the first log line…
install.noLog: No installation log available (the panel was restarted).

files.deleteBody_one: This item will be deleted permanently:
files.deleteBody_other: These {{count}} items will be deleted permanently:
files.deleteDirsWarning: Folders are deleted with everything inside them.
files.name: Name
files.emptyHint: Drop files here or use Upload.

files.discardConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

schedules.title: Schedule
schedules.subtitle: Automatic restarts, warnings and commands.
schedules.editorDescription: Pick when it runs and what it does, step by step.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.cronHelp: minute hour day month weekday, e.g. 0 4 * * * = every day at 04:00
schedules.warnNote: Warnings use the game's announce command (say). Servers created from a custom command have none, so warnings are skipped there.
schedules.onlyIfRunning: Only when the server is running
schedules.emptyBody: Add a nightly restart with warnings for players, or a backup every few hours.
schedules.customNote: This server was created from a custom command, so scheduled warnings cannot be announced in game. Restarts, commands and backups work.
schedules.deleteBody: Delete "{{name}}"? Its run history goes with it.

validation.name: Give the schedule a name.
validation.wait: Wait must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
validation.totalWait: Waits add up to more than 2 hours.

schedules.txAdminNote: This server uses txAdmin, which has its own restart schedule. Set restarts in one place only (here or in txAdmin), otherwise the server restarts twice.

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Compressed copies of the server folder (tar.zst).
backups.notWritableBody: The panel cannot write to {{dir}}. Check the mount or permissions.
backups.emptyBody: Create the first one now, or add a backup action to a schedule.
backups.restoreWarning: Current server files will be replaced with the backup. Make a fresh backup first if you may need them.
backups.deleteBody: Delete the backup from {{date}} ({{size}})? This cannot be undone.
backups.excludesHelp: One pattern per line. logs/ excludes a folder, *.log a file pattern.
backups.flushMinecraftHelp: Runs save-off / save-all before and save-on after, so the world files are consistent.

profile.title: My account
profile.passwordDescription: Changing the password logs out your other sessions.
profile.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text and copy it manually.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.description: After the password, logging in also asks for a code from an app such as Google Authenticator, Aegis or 1Password.
twoFactor.requiredBody: The owner requires two-factor authentication. Until you enable it below, the rest of the panel stays locked.
twoFactor.scanHelp: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the secret in manually, then enter the code the app shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
twoFactor.codeHelp: 6 digits. If it keeps failing, check that your phone's clock is correct.
twoFactor.backupBody: Each code works once and lets you in if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.savedConfirm: I saved the codes in a safe place
twoFactor.disableLabel: Code from the app or a backup code
twoFactor.disableHelp: Turning 2FA off removes the backup codes too.
twoFactor.disableBlocked: The owner requires 2FA for your account, so it cannot be turned off.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For scripts and automation. A key acts as you, optionally limited to chosen permissions.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.scopeHelp: A key can never do more than your account.
apiKeys.createDescription: The key is shown only once after creation.
apiKeys.tokenBody: Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
apiKeys.usage: Send it in the Authorization header, for example:

users.title: Users
users.createDescription: The person logs in with this name and password and can change the password later.
users.roleHelp: Users only see servers you give them access to. Administrators see and manage everything.
users.resetBody: Set a new password for {{name}}. Their sessions will be logged out.
users.deleteBody: {{name}} will lose access immediately. Their server grants are removed too.

permissions.title: Access for users
permissions.description: Administrators always have full access. Here you choose what regular users may do on this server.
permissions.empty: No user has access to this server yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when. The newest 100 entries.

security.title: Security policy
security.ownerFirstTitle: Enable 2FA on your own account first
security.ownerFirstBody: The policy can be turned on only after the owner has 2FA enabled (see My account).

policyHelp.none: Anyone may enable 2FA, nobody has to.
policyHelp.admins: Administrators and the owner must enable 2FA before using the panel.
policyHelp.all: Every account must enable 2FA before using the panel.

history.noData: No data yet. Statistics are collected while the server runs.
history.noEvents: No events yet. They appear after the server starts for the first time.
history.noProblems: No crashes or errors. Keep it up.

database.adminDescription: MariaDB and phpMyAdmin for FiveM and Minecraft servers on this machine.
database.askOwner: Only the panel owner can start the installation.
database.installStarted: Installation started. It takes a few minutes.
database.phpMyAdminInfo: Database browser as a separate service on port {{port}}. Log in with a server's database credentials.
database.explainIntro: One click installs on this machine:
database.explainMariadb: MariaDB server from the Debian/Ubuntu packages, listening on 127.0.0.1 only (not reachable from outside),
database.explainPhp: PHP CLI with the extensions phpMyAdmin needs (no Apache or nginx),
database.explainPma: phpMyAdmin as a separate service on port 8081,
database.explainTime: installing takes a few minutes; it is safe to run again.
database.tuningNote: MariaDB is tuned for game servers: skip-name-resolve, innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=2 and a buffer pool of 25% of RAM. This keeps oxmysql and plugins from reporting false slow-query warnings. Queries that are really slow (over 1 s) are logged to /var/log/mysql/mariadb-slow.log.
database.terminalTitle: Run the installer in a terminal
database.terminalBody: This panel runs without systemd (dev mode or a container), so it cannot start the installer itself. Run on the machine:
database.installDoneBody: MariaDB and phpMyAdmin are running. Create databases in the Databases tab of a server.
database.installFailedBody: Check the last log lines below, fix the cause and run the installer again.
database.tabSubtitle: A dedicated MariaDB database and user for this server.
database.createBody: The panel creates a database and a user with the same name and a random password.
database.name: Name
database.nameInvalid: Use 1–24 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter.
database.label: Label (optional)
database.notInstalledAskAdmin: Ask an administrator to install MariaDB in the panel.
database.noPermission: You need the server settings permission to manage this server's databases.
database.hintFivem: oxmysql (and the older mysql-async) reads the connection from the set mysql_connection_string line in server.cfg. Copy it from the database credentials.
database.hintMinecraft: Plugins like LuckPerms or CoreProtect ask for host, port, database name, user and password in their config.
database.hintOther: Use the credentials in your application's configuration (host 127.0.0.1, port 3306).
database.empty: This server has no database yet.
database.rotateBody: The old password for {{name}} stops working immediately.
database.rotatedWarning: The password was changed. Update it in server.cfg or your plugin configs and restart the server.
database.deleteBody: The database {{name}} and all its data will be deleted permanently.
database.fivemHint: Paste both lines into server.cfg before “ensure oxmysql”. The second raises oxmysql's warning threshold to 1.5 s: oxmysql times queries inside FXServer, so any server hitch looks like a slow query. The panel also adds it before start if it is missing.
database.minecraftHint: Most plugins want host, port, database, user and password separately (above). Some accept a JDBC URL.
database.phpMyAdminLoginHint: In phpMyAdmin log in as {{user}} with the same password.

root.title: Root login
root.description: By default MariaDB's root can only log in from the server console (sudo mariadb). Add a password here to log in as root in phpMyAdmin. Console login keeps working.
root.warning: Root has full access to every database. phpMyAdmin runs over plain HTTP, so use it on your home network only and do not forward port 8081 on your router. Give game servers their own databases from the server's tab.
root.openPma: Open phpMyAdmin and log in as root
root.placeholder: Type your own password or generate a random one
root.rules: 12–128 characters, no spaces, quotes or backslashes.
root.disableConfirm: Root will only be able to log in from the server console.

database.copyManual: The browser blocked copying. The value is selected, press Ctrl+C.

templateLibrary.title: Templates
templateLibrary.subtitle: Games and apps you can create servers from. Add your own, or import eggs from Pterodactyl, Pelican and PufferPanel templates.
templateLibrary.importHelp: Paste an egg (Pterodactyl, Pelican) or a PufferPanel template, give a link, or upload the JSON file. You can review and edit the result before saving.
templateLibrary.dockerNote: Those panels run servers in Docker; HomePanel runs them directly on this machine. Package installs (apt, apk) in install scripts are skipped, so install any required system packages yourself.
templateLibrary.urlHelp: Must start with https://. On GitHub use the “Raw” link.
templateLibrary.fileTooLarge: That file is too large (max 2 MB).
templateLibrary.reviewHelp: This is the converted template. Check it, fix anything flagged above, then save.
templateLibrary.existsChangeId: A template with this id already exists. Change the id on the first line, or replace the existing one.
templateLibrary.overrideBuiltin: The id “{{id}}” belongs to a built-in template. Saving will replace it with your version; deleting yours later brings the original back.
templateLibrary.editorHelp: Templates are written in YAML. Every field is described in
templateLibrary.viewHelp: Built-in templates cannot be edited. Duplicate this one to make your own version.
templateLibrary.idChanged: The id cannot be changed while editing. Set it back to “{{id}}”, or duplicate the template to use a new id.
templateLibrary.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from the list of templates. Servers that already exist keep running.
templateLibrary.inUseHelp: Those servers keep working, but you will not be able to reinstall them from this template.
templateLibrary.restoreBody: Your version of “{{name}}” will be deleted and the built-in one will be used again.
templateLibrary.emptyCustom: No templates here yet. Import one or create a new one.
templateLibrary.scriptWarning: This template runs an install script from {{source}} on your machine. Only use templates you trust.

platform.label: Server
platform.dialogBody: The panel picks plugins and mods that match the server software and Minecraft version. Only change this if detection got it wrong.
platform.unknownTitle: We don't know what this server runs
platform.unknownBody: The panel could not recognise the server software (e.g. Paper, Fabric, Forge). Pick it below and the search will only show matching plugins or mods.
platform.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to set the server type.

installed.empty_plugins: No plugins yet. Find your first one below.
installed.empty_mods: No mods yet. Find your first one below.

delete.title: Delete this file?
delete.body: {{name}} will be removed from the server. Its config files are kept.

search.title: Search Modrinth
search.subtitle_plugins: Only plugins that match your server and version are shown.
search.subtitle_mods: Only mods that match your server and version are shown (client-only mods are hidden).
search.empty: Nothing found for this server and version.

versions.title: Versions: {{name}}
versions.body: Only versions that match your server. The newest one is installed by default.

restart.title: Changes apply after a server restart
restart.body: The server loads plugins and mods when it starts.

vanilla.title: Vanilla has no add-on support
vanilla.body: Vanilla supports neither plugins nor mods. Use the Paper or Purpur template for plugins, Fabric for mods.

alerts.title: Discord alerts
alerts.description: When a server or bot goes down and does not come back on its own, the panel posts to your Discord channel.
alerts.saveFirst: Save your changes first; the test uses the saved webhook.

webhook.title: Discord webhook
webhook.description: Where the panel posts messages. Treat it like a password.
webhook.label: Webhook URL
webhook.savedPlaceholder: Saved ({{hint}}) — type a new one to replace it
webhook.willRemove: The webhook will be removed when you save
webhook.invalid: This does not look like a Discord webhook (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
webhook.how1: In Discord open Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
webhook.how2: Click “New Webhook” and give it a name.
webhook.how3: Click “Copy Webhook URL” and paste it here.

when.title: When and whom to notify
when.description: The panel waits a moment because servers usually restart on their own. It only pings when the server is really down.

mention.label: Who to ping
mention.idHint: Turn on Developer Mode in Discord (Settings → Advanced), then right-click the role or person → Copy ID.

grace.label: Alert after how many seconds
grace.hint: Give the server time to restart by itself. If it is still down after this, you get pinged.

switches.recovered: Notify when the server is back up
switches.autoRestart: Also notify when it crashed but restarted by itself
switches.autoRestartHint: No ping, just a message in the channel.
switches.logsHint: Logs may contain console data (e.g. player IP addresses).
switches.errorsHint: A message on big errors in the log, even while the server runs. Can be noisy.

panelUrl.label: Panel address
panelUrl.hint: Used for the “Open in panel” link in messages.
panelUrl.invalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

history.title: Recent alerts
history.description: Messages sent since the panel started.

server.title: Discord alerts
server.description: Alerts when this server goes down and does not come back on its own.
server.webhookHint: E.g. a separate channel for this bot. Empty = the webhook from the panel settings.
server.noWebhook: No Discord webhook is set. Ask an administrator to set up alerts.
server.noWebhookAdmin: No Discord webhook is set yet.

ports.anywayHint: The two servers will not be able to run at the same time.

gitUpdate.title: Update from git
gitUpdate.description: Fetches the latest code from the repository, installs dependencies and starts the bot again.
gitUpdate.confirm: We will fetch the latest code from the branch, install dependencies and start the bot again. Local changes to files from the repository will be overwritten.
gitUpdate.restartHelp: Off: the bot starts only if it was running before the update.

portHelp.firewallActive: The firewall ({{kind}}) is on — open the ports with this command on the server:
portHelp.commands: Commands (paste in a terminal as root)
portHelp.notAutomatic: The panel never changes the firewall itself. Run the command once; it stays.
portHelp.noFirewall: No active firewall (ufw/firewalld) found on this machine — nothing to open here.
portHelp.howToTitle: How do I check that the port is open from the internet?
portHelp.step1: On your router, forward port {{ports}} to this machine.
portHelp.step2: Start the server in the panel.
portHelp.step3: From a phone on mobile data (not Wi-Fi), connect to the game, or enter your public IP and port on a “port checker” website.
portHelp.step4: If your router's public IP differs from what a “what is my IP” site shows, you are behind CGNAT and forwarding will not work. Use Tailscale or playit.gg instead.

panelUpdate.title: Panel update
panelUpdate.description: A new panel version from GitHub. Game servers keep running; only the panel restarts.
panelUpdate.noReleases: No releases published on GitHub yet (repo {{repo}}).
panelUpdate.updating: Updating the panel… game servers keep running. The page reloads by itself.
panelUpdate.terminalOnly: This panel runs without systemd — update it from a terminal: sudo homepanel update
panelUpdate.timeout: The panel did not come back within 5 minutes after the update. Check: journalctl -u homepanel-update

sftp.title: Connect with SFTP
sftp.password: Password: the one you use for the panel. Protocol: SFTP (not FTP).
sftp.allServers: With the username “{{username}}” (no suffix) you see all your servers as folders.
sftp.openHint: Works when WinSCP or FileZilla handles sftp:// links.
sftp.fingerprintHint: Your app shows this fingerprint on the first connection. Accept it if it matches.
